title: No live system indicator that FIPS enforcement requires rmmod to deactivate
description: The fact that FIPS enforcement (fips_provider_count > 0) can only be deactivated by unloading all FIPS provider modules is documented in registry.c:37-43 as a code comment, but is not observable from a running system. CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS exposes fips_state but carries no text explaining the deactivation mechanism. A support engineer who sees fips_state=OPERATIONAL and wants to test without FIPS has no kernel-level pointer to the answer. Fix: add a sysfs attribute (e.g., /sys/class/misc/crypto2dev/fips_enforcement) that reads 'active (deactivate by rmmod <provider>)' or 'inactive' when a FIPS provider is/is not loaded. Alternatively, add a note to the DESIGN.md that is observable via the device's sysfs documentation.
